class.name: WebTorrentLobbyDirectory
class.brief_description: Lists WebRTC rooms on WebTorrent trackers.
class.description: A host is listed while its session is the server of a WebRTC room and its [NetwServerInfo] is [constant NetwServerInfo.VISIBILITY_PUBLIC]. Joining a listed room goes through the WebRTC transport. Without this node nothing is listed or browsed, and a room is still joined by its code. A room signaled through a game's own [NetwWebRTCSignaler] is never listed.

members.member: The tracker URLs to browse and announce on. Empty uses the public defaults.
